arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالطّورِ
transliteration: Waalttoori
translation: By the Mount

arabic: وَكِتٰبٍ مَسطورٍ
transliteration: Wakitabin mastoorin
translation: And a Scripture inscribed

arabic: فى رَقٍّ مَنشورٍ
transliteration: Fee raqqin manshoorin
translation: On fine parchment unrolled

arabic: وَالبَيتِ المَعمورِ
transliteration: Waalbayti almaAAmoori
translation: And the House frequented

arabic: وَالسَّقفِ المَرفوعِ
transliteration: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi
translation: And the roof exalted

arabic: وَالبَحرِ المَسجورِ
transliteration: Waalbahri almasjoori
translation: And the sea kept filled

arabic: إِنَّ عَذابَ رَبِّكَ لَوٰقِعٌ
transliteration: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun
translation: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass

arabic: ما لَهُ مِن دافِعٍ
transliteration: Ma lahu min dafiAAin
translation: There is none that can ward it off

arabic: يَومَ تَمورُ السَّماءُ مَورًا
transliteration: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran
translation: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving

arabic: وَتَسيرُ الجِبالُ سَيرًا
transliteration: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran
translation: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement

arabic: فَوَيلٌ يَومَئِذٍ لِلمُكَذِّبينَ
transliteration: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
translation: Then woe that day unto the deniers

arabic: الَّذينَ هُم فى خَوضٍ يَلعَبونَ
transliteration: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona
translation: Who play in talk of grave matters

arabic: يَومَ يُدَعّونَ إِلىٰ نارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
transliteration: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan
translation: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

arabic: هٰذِهِ النّارُ الَّتى كُنتُم بِها تُكَذِّبونَ
transliteration: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona
translation: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny

arabic: أَفَسِحرٌ هٰذا أَم أَنتُم لا تُبصِرونَ
transliteration: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona
translation: Is this magic, or do ye not see

arabic: اصلَوها فَاصبِروا أَو لا تَصبِروا سَواءٌ عَلَيكُم إِنَّما تُجزَونَ ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
transliteration: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona
translation: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do

arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَنَعيمٍ
transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin
translation: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight

arabic: فٰكِهينَ بِما ءاتىٰهُم رَبُّهُم وَوَقىٰهُم رَبُّهُم عَذابَ الجَحيمِ
transliteration: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi
translation: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire

arabic: كُلوا وَاشرَبوا هَنيـًٔا بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona
translation: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do

arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ عَلىٰ سُرُرٍ مَصفوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجنٰهُم بِحورٍ عينٍ
transliteration: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
translation: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

arabic: وَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَاتَّبَعَتهُم ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإيمٰنٍ أَلحَقنا بِهِم ذُرِّيَّتَهُم وَما أَلَتنٰهُم مِن عَمَلِهِم مِن شَيءٍ كُلُّ امرِئٍ بِما كَسَبَ رَهينٌ
transliteration: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun
translation: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned

arabic: وَأَمدَدنٰهُم بِفٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحمٍ مِمّا يَشتَهونَ
transliteration: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona
translation: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire

arabic: يَتَنٰزَعونَ فيها كَأسًا لا لَغوٌ فيها وَلا تَأثيمٌ
transliteration: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun
translation: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin

arabic: وَيَطوفُ عَلَيهِم غِلمانٌ لَهُم كَأَنَّهُم لُؤلُؤٌ مَكنونٌ
transliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun
translation: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls

arabic: وَأَقبَلَ بَعضُهُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ يَتَساءَلونَ
transliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
translation: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning

arabic: قالوا إِنّا كُنّا قَبلُ فى أَهلِنا مُشفِقينَ
transliteration: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena
translation: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious

arabic: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَينا وَوَقىٰنا عَذابَ السَّمومِ
transliteration: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi
translation: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire

arabic: إِنّا كُنّا مِن قَبلُ نَدعوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ البَرُّ الرَّحيمُ
transliteration: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu
translation: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful

arabic: فَذَكِّر فَما أَنتَ بِنِعمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكاهِنٍ وَلا مَجنونٍ
transliteration: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin
translation: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman

arabic: أَم يَقولونَ شاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيبَ المَنونِ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni
translation: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time

arabic: قُل تَرَبَّصوا فَإِنّى مَعَكُم مِنَ المُتَرَبِّصينَ
transliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena
translation: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant

arabic: أَم تَأمُرُهُم أَحلٰمُهُم بِهٰذا أَم هُم قَومٌ طاغونَ
transliteration: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona
translation: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk

arabic: أَم يَقولونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَل لا يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona
translation: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe

arabic: فَليَأتوا بِحَديثٍ مِثلِهِ إِن كانوا صٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena
translation: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful

arabic: أَم خُلِقوا مِن غَيرِ شَيءٍ أَم هُمُ الخٰلِقونَ
transliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona
translation: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators

arabic: أَم خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بَل لا يوقِنونَ
transliteration: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona
translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing

arabic: أَم عِندَهُم خَزائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَم هُمُ المُصَۣيطِرونَ
transliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona
translation: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)

arabic: أَم لَهُم سُلَّمٌ يَستَمِعونَ فيهِ فَليَأتِ مُستَمِعُهُم بِسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin
translation: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest

arabic: أَم لَهُ البَنٰتُ وَلَكُمُ البَنونَ
transliteration: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona
translation: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons

arabic: أَم تَسـَٔلُهُم أَجرًا فَهُم مِن مَغرَمٍ مُثقَلونَ
transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
translation: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt

arabic: أَم عِندَهُمُ الغَيبُ فَهُم يَكتُبونَ
transliteration: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona
translation: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down

arabic: أَم يُريدونَ كَيدًا فَالَّذينَ كَفَروا هُمُ المَكيدونَ
transliteration: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona
translation: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared

arabic: أَم لَهُم إِلٰهٌ غَيرُ اللَّهِ سُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
transliteration: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona
translation: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

arabic: وَإِن يَرَوا كِسفًا مِنَ السَّماءِ ساقِطًا يَقولوا سَحابٌ مَركومٌ
transliteration: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun
translation: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds

arabic: فَذَرهُم حَتّىٰ يُلٰقوا يَومَهُمُ الَّذى فيهِ يُصعَقونَ
transliteration: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona
translation: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken

arabic: يَومَ لا يُغنى عَنهُم كَيدُهُم شَيـًٔا وَلا هُم يُنصَرونَ
transliteration: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona
translation: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped

arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا عَذابًا دونَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَهُم لا يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not

arabic: وَاصبِر لِحُكمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعيُنِنا وَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ حينَ تَقومُ
transliteration: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu
translation: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest

arabic: وَمِنَ الَّيلِ فَسَبِّحهُ وَإِدبٰرَ النُّجومِ
transliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi
translation: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars
